rows.reply: The complimentary checked baggage allowance is 23 kg per passenger for all domestic flights. Each checked bag’s dimensions (length + width + height) must not exceed 158 cm (62 inches). For safety, any individual piece over 32 kg cannot be accepted as checked baggage and must go as cargo. Would you like information on excess baggage charges or pre-booking extra weight?

The maximum weight for your single piece of cabin baggage is 7 kg. Passengers may also carry one small personal item (like a laptop bag or small handbag) that must fit under the seat. Would you like help checking whether a specific bag meets the limit?

Excess baggage at the airport is charged at a flat rate of Rs 500 per kg. Charges must be paid in full at the airport check-in counter before a boarding pass can be issued. You may pre-book additional baggage weight online through the ACME Bharat Airlines website or mobile app up to 2 hours before departure to access discounted rates. 

Would you like help pre-booking additional baggage?

Sorry to hear your bag didn’t arrive. 

- Please report the delayed baggage and file a Property Irregularity Report (PIR) at the airport baggage service desk within 4 hours of arrival.  
- ACME Bharat Airlines provides interim compensation of Rs 1,000 per day, payable for up to a maximum of 5 days, or until the baggage is delivered, whichever is earlier.  
- If the baggage remains untraced after 21 days from the date of flight arrival, it will be formally classified as lost. For lost baggage, you may claim compensation up to Rs 20,000. To initiate that claim you must submit the PIR, the original baggage tag, and an itemized list of the contents with supporting receipts.

Have you already filed the PIR at the airport baggage service desk?
A bag is considered lost if it remains untraced after 21 days from the date of flight arrival, and passengers can claim compensation up to Rs 20,000. Would you like help with the claim process?

Sorry to hear your suitcase was damaged. You must file a damage report at the airport baggage service desk within 7 days of your arrival. The claim must be accompanied by the original baggage tag and clear photos of the damage. Note ACME Bharat Airlines is not liable for minor wear and tear, scratches, scuffs, or damage from over-packing or inherent defects.  

Do you have the original baggage tag and photos ready?
No. Any individual piece of baggage weighing more than 32 kg cannot be accepted as checked baggage and must be transported as cargo. Would you like help with options for transporting it as cargo?

A 3 hour delay falls in the "Delay of 2-4 hours" tier, so you will be provided with complimentary meal vouchers worth Rs 400, redeemable at designated food and beverage outlets within the departure airport terminal. Would you like help with how to claim your voucher at the airport?

Sorry to hear your flight is delayed. For a delay of 4-6 hours you can choose one of the following options: a Rs 3,000 travel voucher valid for future travel with ACME Bharat Airlines, OR free rebooking onto the next available ACME Bharat Airlines flight to the same destination, subject to seat availability, with all modification fees waived. If you file a claim and it’s approved, payouts are processed within 7 business days from the date of claim verification and approval. Note: there is no compensation under this policy if the delay is caused by weather or air traffic control. Would you like me to help you start a rebooking or a claim?

Sorry you experienced this delay. For a delay of over 6 hours (your delay is 7 hours), you are entitled to choose one of the following options: a full refund of the ticket price for the affected flight sector, OR free rebooking onto an alternative ACME Bharat Airlines flight plus a Rs 5,000 travel voucher valid for future travel. 

You can file a claim at the airport service desk or online through the ACME Bharat Airlines claims portal; approved payouts are processed within 7 business days and refunds are credited back to the original payment method. Note there is no compensation under this policy if the delay was caused by weather or air traffic control. 

Would you like me to guide you on filing the claim at the airport or online?

Yes. For an overnight delay that requires an unscheduled overnight stay, ACME Bharat Airlines will provide complimentary hotel accommodation and will arrange and cover the cost of ground transportation between the airport and the hotel. 

Could you share your booking reference or flight number so I can check this for your reservation?

No. The policy states there is no compensation for delays caused by weather or air traffic control; passengers affected by these external factors "will not be eligible for travel vouchers, monetary refunds, or meal coupons under this policy." Would you like help contacting AcmeConnect for further assistance?

All approved compensation payouts are processed within 7 business days from the date of claim verification and approval. Refunds are credited back to the original mode of payment used during ticket purchase. Would you like help filing a claim at the airport desk or online through AcmeConnect?

You can file a compensation claim either at the airport service desk or online through the official ACME Bharat Airlines claims portal. All approved payouts are processed within 7 business days from the date of claim verification and approval, and refunds are credited back to the original mode of payment used during ticket purchase.  

Would you like help with filing the claim at the airport or online?

Yes. Any cancellation made within 24 hours of booking qualifies for a full refund of the entire ticket price. This applies regardless of the fare type purchased (including non-refundable and promotional fares), and no cancellation fees or penalties will be levied for transactions cancelled within this 24-hour window. You can request the refund via the "Manage Booking" section on our website or by contacting our customer support center. Would you like help with cancelling your booking now?

Refunds for fully-flexible fares are processed and returned to the original form of payment within 5 business days from the date the cancellation request is submitted. Would you like help submitting the cancellation?

If you cancel a non-refundable ticket (outside the initial 24-hour window), the base fare and carrier-imposed charges are non-reimbursable. Government-mandated taxes and airport fees included in the ticket price will be refunded, and the remaining eligible portion of the fare will be returned as a travel credit voucher valid for 12 months from the date of issue. You can request the refund via the "Manage Booking" section on the ACME Bharat Airlines website or by contacting our customer support center. Would you like help locating the "Manage Booking" page?

Sorry to hear your flight was cancelled. You can choose either of the following:

- A full refund of the unused ticket value, returned to the original form of payment.  
- Free rebooking on the next available ACME Bharat Airlines flight to the scheduled destination, with any fare differences and change fees waived.

If the cancellation was due to adverse weather or other force majeure, note that ACME Bharat Airlines will provide no monetary compensation (such as hotel accommodation or meals), but you are still eligible for either free rebooking or a full refund.  

Would you like me to arrange a refund or rebooking?

I’m sorry your flight was cancelled due to the storm. Under our policy for cancellations due to adverse weather or other factors beyond the airline’s control, ACME Bharat Airlines will provide no monetary compensation (such as hotel accommodation or meals). Affected passengers are eligible for either free rebooking on the next available flight or a full refund of their ticket value. 

Would you like me to arrange a free rebooking or process a full refund?

To request a refund, visit the "Manage Booking" section on the ACME Bharat Airlines website or contact our customer support center. For tickets purchased through third-party travel agencies, you must contact your travel agent directly to initiate the refund process.

Please note a few exact details from our policy:
- If you cancel outside the initial 24-hour window, refund eligibility depends on your fare type.  
- Fully-Flexible fares receive a 100% refund, which will be processed and returned to the original form of payment within 5 business days from the date the cancellation request is submitted.  
- Non-Refundable fares: government-mandated taxes and airport fees will be refunded; the remaining eligible portion is returned as a travel credit voucher valid for 12 months from the date of issue.  
- If ACME Bharat cancels the flight, you may receive a full refund to the original form of payment or free rebooking.

Would you like me to help you locate the Manage Booking page or provide the customer support contact?

For tickets purchased through third-party travel agencies, you must contact your travel agent directly to initiate the refund process. Note that if your cancellation is made within 24 hours of booking, it qualifies for a full refund of the entire ticket price. Would you like help drafting a message to your travel agent?

You earn 5 AcmeMiles for every Rs 100 spent on the base fare of an eligible ticket. The base fare calculation excludes government-imposed taxes, airport development fees, passenger service charges, fuel surcharges, and GST. Miles are automatically credited within 48 hours of flight completion if your membership number was entered at booking. Would you like me to check how many miles a specific ticket amount would earn?

You need to earn 50,000 qualifying miles within a single calendar year (January 1 to December 31) to attain Gold tier. Once achieved, the status remains valid for the remainder of that calendar year plus the entirety of the subsequent calendar year. Would you like help checking how many qualifying miles you have so far?

Yes. All accumulated miles shall expire after 24 months of account inactivity. Account inactivity is defined as any continuous 24-month period during which a member does not record any qualifying transaction, such as earning miles through a flight or redeeming miles for an eligible reward. Expired miles are permanently forfeited and cannot be reinstated, transferred, or exchanged for monetary compensation. Would you like help checking when your account last had activity?

Sorry to hear your miles are missing. Any missing miles must be claimed within 90 days of the date of travel. Members must submit a formal claim request accompanied by a copy of their physical or digital boarding pass, along with the ticket receipt. Claims submitted without a valid boarding pass, or those initiated after the 90-day window has elapsed, will be systematically rejected. Note that miles are automatically credited within 48 hours of flight completion if your membership number was entered at booking. 

Do you have your boarding pass and ticket receipt ready to submit?

Miles are automatically credited to your profile within 48 hours of flight completion, provided your membership number was entered at the time of booking. If miles are not credited, you must claim any missing miles within 90 days of the date of travel and submit a copy of your boarding pass plus the ticket receipt; claims without a valid boarding pass or filed after the 90-day window will be rejected. Would you like help with submitting a retroactive claim?

With 100,000 miles in a single calendar year you attain Platinum Tier. Once achieved, that status "remains valid for the remainder of the current calendar year plus the entirety of the subsequent calendar year." Would you like help checking your current tier status?

Yes. Wheelchair assistance is provided entirely free of charge to all passengers who require mobility support. Passengers must request wheelchair assistance at least 48 hours before their scheduled flight departure. Would you like help requesting this service?

You must request wheelchair assistance at least 48 hours before your scheduled flight departure. This service is provided free of charge. Would you like me to arrange wheelchair assistance for your flight?

Yes. The unaccompanied minor service is mandatory for children aged between 5 and 12 years traveling alone, so your 8-year-old can fly as an unaccompanied minor. A service fee of Rs 3,000 per unaccompanied minor per flight sector applies. A parent or guardian must accompany the child to the departure check-in counter, complete the required indemnity forms, and remain at the airport until the flight has departed; at the destination, the child will only be released to the authorized guardian specified in the booking documents. Would you like help arranging the unaccompanied minor service for a specific flight?

At 30 weeks you must have a valid "Fit-to-Fly" certificate — this is mandatory for any passenger who has reached or exceeded 28 weeks of pregnancy. The certificate must be issued by a registered medical practitioner or obstetrician within 7 days of the scheduled departure date, must clearly state the estimated date of delivery, confirm that the pregnancy is uncomplicated, and certify that you are fit to travel by air.  

When is your scheduled departure?

Your CPAP machine is an approved personal medical device and is carried free of charge and does not count toward your standard checked or cabin baggage allowance. Passengers must inform the airline at least 48 hours before departure if the device requires battery power. Would you like help with pre-notifying us 48 hours before your flight?
The fit-to-fly certificate must be issued within 7 days of the scheduled departure date. Would you like help with what details the certificate must include?

Checked baggage: har passenger ke liye complimentary allowance 23 kg hai; har bag ki dimensions (L+W+H) max 158 cm (62 inches) honi chahiye, aur kisi bhi ek piece ka weight 32 kg se zyada accept nahin kiya jaega (wo cargo hona chahiye). Cabin baggage: har passenger ko exactly ek piece allowed hai, maximum weight 7 kg, aur saath mein ek chhota personal item (jaise laptop bag) ho sakta hai jo seat ke neeche fit ho. 

Kya aap yeh domestic flight ke liye confirm karna chahte hain?

Agar flight ka delay kul 4-6 ghante hai, to aapko inme se ek chunne ka adhikar hai:  
- Rs 3,000 ka travel voucher jo ACME Bharat Airlines mein bhavishya ke safar ke liye valid hai, YA  
- Agle uplabdh ACME Bharat Airlines flight par free rebooking (seat availability ke subject) aur saare modification fees maaf kar diye jayenge.

Kya aap voucher lena chaheinge ya rebooking karwani hai?

Aapke accumulated miles tab expire hote hain jab account mein continuous 24 months ki inactivity ho — yani 24 months ke dauran koi qualifying transaction (mile earn ya redeem) record na ho. Expired miles permanently forfeited ho jate hain aur unhe reinstated, transferred, ya monetary compensation ke liye exchange nahi kiya ja sakta. 

Kya main aapki account activity check karne mein madad karun?
